questions.q: True or false? At this goal kick, the ball is in play once kicked and moving.
questions.explain: Right, it's true. Once the kick clearly moves the ball, play is on.
choiceExplanations: Right, it's true. Once the kick clearly moves the ball, play is on.
In this example the ball does not need to leave the area; a clear kick starts play.

questions.q: Which picture gives the goalkeeper two short passes that one forward can't both block?
questions.explain: Yes. Split wide, one forward cannot block both routes, so one stays open.
choiceExplanations: Yes. Split wide, one forward cannot block both routes, so one stays open.
Close together, one forward can block both passes at once.
With one defender inside, there is only one wide route to use.

questions.q: Now two opponents block both side routes. Which short pass is still open?
questions.explain: Yes. Both side routes are blocked, so the center defender is the free short option.
choiceExplanations: Blue's winger has stepped into that route, so the pass could be cut out.
